summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against sibling math_init.js on npm install. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs) with string-array rotation obfuscation (WV8StW push/shift shuffler over an n7gIxM string table) and hex-mangled identifiers, whose contents are not human-readable. The package advertises itself as a Vue regex component library and has no functional reason to fetch an alternate language runtime and execute an opaque bundle at install time. The package name @onereach/regular-expressions-test differs by a -test suffix from @onereach/regular-expressions, and homepage, git repository, and README all point to the non--test package, consistent with a trojanized sibling of the legitimate package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
